column1: # windows_coverage.tsv — #492 / PRD #475 Solution 6: which test actually RUNS on Windows for each `✓` row of the
# parity matrix (docs/reference.md). test/test_windows_parity_doc.sh fails on a `✓` row with no line here, on a line
# whose test file is missing or skips itself for want of tmux (that is a test Windows does not run), and on a line for a
# row the matrix does not have or marks `n/a` on Windows.
# Format: <matrix row, no backticks> TAB <test files in test/, space separated>. A row needs one running test, not all.
